def: a track (as a wheel-rut), i.e. (figuratively) a course of conduct

occurrences.text: And make straight paths for your feet, lest that which is lame be turned out of the way; but let it rather be healed.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
